what: Whether a Village Brain section reaches a member through the guide
why: briefForPublicPrompt feeds the proposal guide's system prompt and no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set on this local build. The write, the audience filter and the direct markdown read at GET /api/village/brain are all proved; the guide's use of them is not.
wouldNeed: An LLM key on a scratch build, or a unit-level assertion over the composed prompt.

what: Whether an admin Tools save reaches the member /tools page
why: Every attempt was refused before it wrote. The tools module ships with no categories and POST /api/admin/tools requires one. The category editor exists (components/admin/ModuleConfigPanels.tsx:486), so the refusal points at a real door; the run ended before I walked it. The cold-reload line reading GONE for tools is this, not a defect.
wouldNeed: Add a category through the module config panel, then create a tool and read /api/tools.

what: Anything behind the sign-in wall on LIVE
why: Live was signed out and read only by instruction, and no production tokens were minted this round. Every operator finding here is therefore LOCAL, at the same SHA.
wouldNeed: A production credential, which the coordinator deliberately did not issue.

what: Whether the fresh-fork content leak also stands on LIVE
why: Live is a configured village, not a fork, so its /team is legitimately Amora's. The finding is about what an empty schema produces at first boot and cannot be observed on a configured deployment.
wouldNeed: A second empty deployment, which is exactly what the local scratch schema was.
